entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marcia Angell is an American physician, author, and the first woman to serve as editor-in-chief of the New England Journal of Medicine. She is currently a Corresponding Member of the Faculty of Global Health and Social Medicine at Harvard Medical School in Boston, Massachusetts.
